violation_type.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Confine in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2805(2))
violation_type.short_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Confine in a Restrictive Device
violation_type.typical_finding: A four-month-old child was sleeping in a restrictive device (swing) covered in a blanket.     NOTE: This was correct at inspection when the child was moved to the play yard.

finding_variants.text: A four-month-old child was sleeping in a restrictive device (swing) covered in a blanket.     NOTE: This was correct at inspection when the child was moved to the play yard.
A two year old was seen sleeping in a restrictive device.
A 2 year old was seen sleeping in a restrictive device. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver move the child.
